summary: Iter915 — Validated Travel Visa Country Track feature (backend + frontend). All 5 backend pytest cases pass (free/admin/404/401/telemetry). Frontend E2E confirms deep-link ?country=US opens Country Track view, hero + 8 visa-type chips render, 6 track cards render sorted free→basic→premium (Tourist FREE unlocked, 3 BASIC + 2 PREMIUM locked), Unlock buttons open the TravelVisaUpgradePrompt modal (tv-v2-upgrade-modal), View Lessons toggle expands the free track lesson list, AI Checklist visa-type chip enables the Generate button, Back button clears ?country= and returns to Explore, and light+dark theme render cleanly. Onboarding overlay Skip dismiss works. Overall feature is production ready.

issues: US is NOT visible in Top Countries grid (regionFilteredCountries.slice(0,16) sorted alphabetically → US falls outside first 16). Users reach US only via Trending chips or deep-link. Consider prioritising popular=true countries in the Top Countries grid so the conversion path stays discoverable.

action_items: (Optional) Elevate popular/trending countries (incl. US, UK, UAE, Singapore) in Top Countries grid rather than alphabetical slice(0,16), so the primary conversion CTA is prominent.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoint /api/travel-visa/countries/{code}/track correctly excludes _id (find with {_id:0}) and enforces auth via require_auth + _ensure_user_scope. Telemetry insert is wrapped in try/except so failures don't break UX. Track sort order (tier_rank → name) is stable.

Frontend: React Native for Web only propagates data-testid onto interactive Touchable* elements — nested <View data-testid=...> wrappers on TravelVisaCountryTrack.tsx (e.g. tv-v2-country-track-hero, tv-v2-country-checklist, per-track wrapper tv-v2-track-cat-*) DO NOT actually reach the DOM. Interactive testids (tv-v2-country-track-back, tv-v2-track-unlock-*, tv-v2-track-toggle-*, tv-v2-checklist-generate, tv-v2-checklist-type-*) do render. Consider using RN-web-friendly `nativeID` or wrapping in Pressable so wrapper testids survive; this affects automated testing but not user functionality.
TravelVisaMain.tsx line 353 uses regionFilteredCountries.slice(0,16) after default alphabetical sort — see design_issues above.
openCountryTrack / closeCountryTrack correctly sync router.setParams for deep-linkable URLs; verified round-trip works.
